search_text: published ZDI-26-268 ZDI-CAN-28705 Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server Incorrect Default Permissions Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2026-04-15 CVE-2026-25203 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-25203 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Samsung'] ['MagicINFO 9 Server'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the product installer. The issue results from incorrect permissions on a folder used by the product. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. title: Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server Incorrect Default Permissions Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Samsung MagicINFO 9 Server. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the product installer. The issue results from incorrect permissions on a folder used by the product. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.
